ORDER  UNDER   SECTION  2A  OF  VALUE  ADDED  TAX  ACT,  No.  14 OF  2002  AS  AMENDED  BY
BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 2A of the Value Added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2002, as amended by Act, No.
06 of 2005, I, Mahinda Rajapaksa, Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development do by this Order amend the
Order made under said Section 2A and published in the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 2151/52 dated November
29, 2019 by the addition immediately after Paragraph 3 thereto, of the following new paragraph.
